description: This file defines the utility class 'AudioUtils' that provides a static method to read audio data from an AudioRecord object into a buffer, with detailed logging and trace sections, primarily used for audio processing within an Android application.

classes.name: AudioUtils
classes.description: A utility class for handling audio recording operations, specifically reading audio data from an AudioRecord instance into a buffer.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified amount of audio data from an AudioRecord object into a byte buffer, with logging and tracing, for a given duration specified in seconds.
